We did not come to Congress to protect a broken system. We came to tear it down.

357 Members teamed up to kill our resolution and keep Congressional sexual harassment records buried. So we took it a step further. We made a motion to subpoena the slush fund files, it passed, and we released the names and settlement amounts of every Member who used your tax dollars to cover up sexual misconduct. Over $550,000. Seven former Members. Paid by you, hidden from you.

You put us here to fight for you.
